svg.title: Human heart — original educational cutaway
svg.desc: Patient right is viewer left. Four chambers and four distinct valve ports model normal postnatal circulation. A thick left ventricular wall and continuous septum separate the ventricular cavities. Blue denotes oxygen-poor and carmine oxygen-rich blood as an educational convention. Geometry, vessel branches and timing are authored illustration, not measured or clinically certified anatomy. NIH NIAID BioArt is retained separately as an exterior reference and supplies no internal anatomy to this drawing.
